units.source_text: 光阴荏苒，岁月空过，冷泉帝在位已有一十八年。

en.t: Time slipped by and the years passed in vain; Emperor Reizei had already been on the throne for eighteen years.

units.source_text: 他近年来心里常想，口上常说：

en.t: In recent years he often thought to himself, and often said aloud:

units.source_text: “我没有亲生的皇子可以嗣位，不免寂寥之感。

en.t: I have no son of my own who can inherit the throne, and I cannot help feeling lonely because of it.

units.source_text: 况且人生如梦，世事无常，我很想辞去皇位，

en.t: Besides, life is like a dream and worldly affairs are impermanent, so I very much wish to give up the throne,

units.source_text: 放心地和亲爱的人叙叙，做做私人所心爱的事，

en.t: to speak freely with those dear to me and do the private things I love,

units.source_text: 逍遥自在地度送岁月才好。”

en.t: and spend my remaining years at ease and in freedom. That would be best.

units.source_text: 最近他生了一场重病，便突然地让位。

en.t: Recently he fell gravely ill, and then suddenly abdicated.

units.source_text: 世人都很惋惜，说道：“主上春秋鼎盛，怎么就让位了？”

en.t: Everyone in the world deeply regretted it and said, The sovereign is still in the prime of life, so why has he abdicated?

units.source_text: 但皇太子已经长大成人，便即了帝位。

en.t: But the crown prince had already grown to adulthood, and so he ascended the imperial throne.

units.source_text: 天下政治并无多大变更。

en.t: The government of the realm underwent no great change.
